question: Component on motherboard does not includes ________________.
solution:
**The correct option is (4)**

Graphic Card

__**Concept:-**__

The circuit board of a computer system is referred to as the **motherboard, **often known as the mainboard or logic board. The ROM, CPU, RAM, BIOS Chip, CMOS Battery, and other components are all connected to the motherboard via various connections. The motherboard acts as the system's building block when it first starts to run.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The motherboard, the biggest part of the computer system, is in charge of connecting and regulating all other parts.
 
• One or more processor Cores are included on an integrated circuit known as a **processor Chip, commonly referred to as a "CPU."**
 
• The motherboard's BIOS settings are kept in memory by the CMOS battery. The CMOS battery has the ability to store data and time as well.
 
• A non-volatile microchip inserted on the computer's motherboard called a BIOS chip frequently houses the basic input/output system (BIOS) of the device.
 
• **Graphic card **analyzes and processes data using complex graphical features, functions, and techniques to provide a high-quality visual presentation. The purpose of a graphic card is to render graphics.
 
• Our computer cannot show any information or perform as we need it to without a **graphic card.**
